title: Rudeness Multiplier
one_liner: Type a prompt and see a simulated 'performance score' comparing a polite vs. a rude version, based on the cited Penn State study.
headline: Type a prompt, watch a polite vs. rude rewrite race on a simulated score, then get called out by the hosts' own ethical pushback.

episode.title: OpenAI Bulk-Solves 722 Math Problems, Anthropic’s Cruelty Policy, and Elon’s Quadrillion-Dollar SpaceX | EP #302

history.summary: A well-executed, self-contained demo that nails the brief: the rude/polite auto-rewrite, animated bar race, and closing disclaimer card quoting Anthropic's stance and Dave's "brusque beats abusive" counter-point all work as described. Honesty is handled carefully — the real 84.8%/80.8% baseline is clearly separated from the labeled heuristic per-prompt score, and the "rude" rewrite stays blunt rather than genuinely abusive, which smartly sidesteps the risk flagged in the idea brief.
